description: Capture a screenshot of the full screen, a specific display (by 0-based index), a named app window, or a pixel region. Always saves a full-resolution PNG to disk (defaulting to ~/Desktop). Optionally returns a downscaled JPEG preview (max 1024px wide) as base64 for agent visual analysis — keeping response size manageable. Window capture requires Screen Recording permission; all other targets do not.

app_name.description: App name for target=window, e.g. "Safari". App must be running and not minimized.

display_index.description: 0-based display index for target=display. 0 is the primary display. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

include_data.description: When true, returns a downscaled JPEG preview as base64 in the response for agent visual analysis. Defaults to false.

path.description: Absolute path for the output PNG. Defaults to MACOS_SCREENSHOT_DIR/<timestamp>.png (~/Desktop if not configured). Must be within ~/Desktop, /tmp, or the home directory.

region.description: Pixel region to capture for target=region.

height.description: Region height in pixels. Must be greater than 0.

width.description: Region width in pixels. Must be greater than 0.

x.description: Left edge x-coordinate. Negative for displays left of the primary.

y.description: Top edge y-coordinate. Negative for displays above the primary.

target.description: screen — full screen; window — a named app window (requires Screen Recording); display — a specific connected display; region — a pixel rectangle.

name: macos_take_screenshot

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `screen_recording_required`: target=window called without Screen Recording permission. `window_not_found`: No visible window for the named app is found. `display_not_found`: display_index references a display not in the current configuration. `path_not_writable`: The target path or MACOS_SCREENSHOT_DIR does not exist or is not writable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

path.description: Absolute path to the full-resolution PNG written to disk.

preview.description: Base64-encoded JPEG preview (max 1024px wide, ~70% quality). Present only when include_data=true.

preview_height.description: Preview image height in pixels. Present when include_data=true.

preview_width.description: Preview image width in pixels. Present when include_data=true.

title: Take macOS Screenshot
